title: 宇树科技CFO：硬件已极致，大脑灵活性成行业新赛道
speaker: Jesse Liu

segments.en: Yeah. Please make sure to be there. We have, obviously, we displayed some things at WAIC in Shanghai last month. And it's going to be a lot more for WRC. Obviously, it's a more robot-focused event. So there's going to be more robotic stuff, hardware, geeky hardware stuff, and some more stuff on our progress in our brain system, right?
segments.zh: 请务必到场。上个月我们在上海WAIC展示了一些东西，这次WRC会更多。这是更聚焦机器人的活动，会有更多硬件、极客硬件，以及我们在大脑系统方面的进展。

segments.en: And our progress with new types of data, new work that we've done with sort of world action models, egocentric data, we've done a lot of work surrounding this new sort of data type. And yeah, a lot of that result is going to be on display live, which is quite important at WRC.
segments.zh: 我们在新数据类型、世界动作模型、第一视角数据方面做了很多工作，很多成果将在WRC现场展示，这非常重要。

segments.en: There's so many startups that are kind of in this space. I think it's more than 300 or so right now. What do you think is the right sort of strategy to really survive in this sort of industry right now? Is it that it's not just the hardware alone, you kind of have to have that sort of AI full stack capability as well? Yeah, yeah. So whether it's to have it, or you have to understand it first, I think, because it's not anywhere near mature, I would say, when it's mature, this is going to be the biggest, one of the biggest markets verticals in the world.
segments.zh: 这个领域有300多家初创公司。你认为在这个行业生存的正确策略是什么？是不是不仅要有硬件，还要有AI全栈能力？是的，要么拥有，要么先理解。因为行业远未成熟，一旦成熟，这将是全球最大的垂直市场之一。

segments.en: It's still a small distance from being fully mature, but you have to understand the trends, you have to understand where it's headed. A lot of the most frontier stuff is still in academia, to be honest. How to bridge that gap between academia and industry is quite important for us as well.
segments.zh: 距离完全成熟还有一段距离，但你必须理解趋势和方向。说实话，很多前沿研究还在学术界。如何弥合学术界与产业界的鸿沟对我们来说非常重要。

segments.en: And how to bridge that gap between the brain system and the hardware itself, because that's very interconnected. The hardware is actually configured the way that's most optimized to carry out the structure of the brain system, right? So the hardware at the same time is changing. So you have to, as hardware makers, with the brain system, we have to understand both. How do we, a lot of the focus within the industry in the last few years has been, I think, one simply has to look at whether that's dancing robots, fighting robots, running robots in America, the dexterity of the hardware.
segments.zh: 如何弥合大脑系统与硬件之间的鸿沟，因为它们紧密相连。硬件配置是为了最优执行大脑系统的结构，硬件也在变化。作为硬件制造商，我们必须两者都理解。过去几年行业焦点一直在硬件灵活性上，比如跳舞机器人、格斗机器人、跑步机器人。

segments.en: But how do you improve the dexterity of the brain? So what is that conversation like within the industry now? Yeah, the dexterity of the body is something that's a solvable engineering problem. I think that's something that we've optimized the max. Almost of the max, right? You have marathon running robots, you have boxing robots, you have robots that do very extreme parkour stuff. I'm not sure if you've seen those.
segments.zh: 但如何提升大脑的灵活性？行业内的讨论是怎样的？身体的灵活性是可解决的工程问题，我们已经优化到极致。有跑马拉松的机器人、拳击机器人、跑酷机器人，你见过吗？
